summary: Frontend-only regression QA of ARSHNAZ RTL app on https://arshiam-preview.preview.emergentagent.com (viewport 1920x900 + 390x844). Verified sidebar restructure, Kanban empty state and goal-editor flow, legacy default goal hiding, sync-status bar behaviour, PWA no-toast on fresh load, smart-list & buckets toolbars, dark theme toggle, and no-console-errors on primary routes. Login via disclaimer checkbox + test.arshnaz@example.com / Test123456 succeeded.

ui_bugs.issue: Missing data-testid="tasks-toggle-filter" on the filter (funnel) button in the list-view toolbar. Review spec explicitly requires this testid. Visual funnel icon is present but has no testid so automation & the review acceptance criterion cannot key on it.

The kanban goal quick-add row shows both a leading '+' button AND the input placeholder still starts with '+ افزودن تسک جدید به «...»' — visually reads as a double plus. Review spec for the tasks toolbar says '+ placeholder افزودن تسک به «...» (no double plus)'. On /app/smart, /app/inbox, /app/today this is clean (svg-plus + text 'افزودن تسک به «اینباکس/امروز»' with 0 raw '+' chars), but /app/kanban still has the '+' literal in the placeholder text.

verified_flows.auth: PASS - disclaimer checkbox + email/password lands on /app/today. No console errors.
verified_flows.sidebar_primary_nav: PASS - data-testid=sidebar-primary-nav contains exactly ['امروز','صندوق ورودی','بازه‌های کلی','تقویم']. No 'کانبان' in primary. Expanding sidebar-section-do reveals: فردا, ۷ روز آینده, خاطرات روزانه, افراد, کانبان, پومودورو, آمار و خلاصه (کانبان present here; بازه‌های کلی NOT duplicated in the group).
verified_flows.kanban_empty_state: PASS - /app/kanban with no user goals shows data-testid=kanban-empty-goals block with title 'هنوز هدفی تعریف نکرده‌ای' and button 'هدف جدید' (data-testid=kanban-empty-add-goal). No sample default goals visible. Header h1 = 'کانبان'. No goal tabs prior to add.
verified_flows.kanban_goal_creation: PASS - Clicking kanban-empty-add-goal opens modal with goal-editor-title-input, goal-editor-folder-select, goal-editor-save. Typing '__TEST_GOAL__' and saving creates a tab '🎯__TEST_GOAL__', header goal-header-title='__TEST_GOAL__', and empty-goal message 'هنوز تسکی برای این هدف نیست' shown.
verified_flows.legacy_default_goal_hidden: PASS - After setting localStorage arshnaz_kanban_goals_v3_<uid> to include id 'a0000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000002' with title 'Legacy Default', /app/kanban does not show a matching goal-tab and body text does not contain 'Legacy Default'.
verified_flows.sync_status_bar: PASS (with note) - On fresh online session with empty queue, data-testid=sync-status-bar is NOT rendered (previous 'Online · last sync' bug is fixed). After injecting a fallback outbox item into localStorage 'arshnaz_offline_outbox_fallback', the bar appears with text '1 تغییر در صف' and data-testid=sync-status-dismiss; clicking dismiss hides the bar as expected. NOTE: sync-status-details is intentionally only rendered when issueItems.length>0 (failedItems for current user OR unattributedItems with no owner claims at all). Simulating with payload.user_id!=current uid marks the op as belonging to another user (neither failed-for-me nor unattributed) so Details doesn't render — that is correct code behaviour, not a bug.
verified_flows.pwa_update_toast: PASS - No 'new version available' toast on fresh load in dev (vite version.json middleware ignores query string).
verified_flows.smart_list_pills: PASS - /app/smart shows 5 pills [smart-profile-preset-high-priority, ...-goals, ...-due-soon, ...-buckets, ...-inbox]. Each pill label has exactly one leading emoji (e.g. '⏳عقب‌افتاده و امروز', no '⏳ ⏳' duplication). Pills, quick-add-collapsed, tasks-toggle-completed and tasks-toggle-split all share the same row (top≈102-108px). smart-profile-reset only appears when a filter is active (not present in default state — correct). No horizontal overflow at 1920 or 390px.
verified_flows.buckets_toolbar: PASS - /app/buckets shows one-line filter row: فیلترها, انجام‌شده‌ها (horizon-toggle-completed) with checkmark, sort dropdown (horizon-sort-trigger 'مرتب‌سازی: اهمیت'), and search input on the same row. Empty day periods render as single slim lines ('خالی — تسک را اینجا رها کن').
verified_flows.dark_theme_toggle: PASS - Clicking data-testid=header-theme-toggle flips html.className 'light' -> 'dark'; page remains readable in dark screenshot.
verified_flows.no_console_errors: PASS - No console errors captured across login, today, kanban, smart, inbox, buckets navigations.

action_items: Add data-testid="tasks-toggle-filter" to the filter (funnel) button in the shared TasksView / SmartListProfileBar toolbar so the review acceptance criterion is satisfied and automation can target it.

Fix /app/kanban quick-add row: remove the leading '+' literal from the placeholder text (KanbanView quick-add input placeholder) or drop the visual '+' button beside the input — currently reads as a double plus (svg + '+ افزودن تسک جدید به «...»'). The /app/smart, /app/inbox, /app/today rows are already correct.
critical_code_review_comments: src/lib/offlineQueue.ts getQueue() concatenates IndexedDB items and localStorage fallback items; if both stores end up with the same record after a partial fallback write, duplicates could accumulate. Consider dedupe by (table, op, createdAt+ownerId) or clear the LS fallback after a successful IDB flush.

src/components/OfflineIndicator.tsx: 'Details' button is only wired to unattributed OR canReplayForOwner-failed items; items that belonged to a different user id (e.g. legacy multi-account testing) stay pending forever with no UI affordance to discard/inspect. Consider surfacing a small 'legacy from other account' hint next to the count.
vite.config.ts versionJsonPlugin returns the same buildId on every request — good; ensure usePwaUpdateToast compares fullVersion (not buildId) to avoid noisy toasts if only build time changes.
KanbanView quick-add: mixing a lucide <Plus/> icon and an in-string '+' in the placeholder duplicates the plus glyph — align with the shared quick-add-collapsed pattern that uses only the icon.

success_rate.frontend: ~93% - 11/12 review acceptance blocks fully pass; 1 missing testid + 1 cosmetic double-plus on kanban

seed_data_creation: Created one kanban goal titled '__TEST_GOAL__' with no folder while testing the empty-state → editor flow. Also transiently injected an item into localStorage 'arshnaz_offline_outbox_fallback' and removed it. Injected a legacy goal id and (attempted) cleanup. Recommend main agent verifying via UI that the test goal is removed or expected to be cleaned by user.
context_for_next_testing_agent: React Router in this app does not react to plain history.pushState — always trigger a popstate event after pushState, or click the actual sidebar link. Firebase Web auth uses IndexedDB (not localStorage) for persistence; you cannot read the uid from localStorage 'firebase:authUser*'. To get the uid in test, either look for a key that starts with 'arshnaz_kanban_goals_v3_' after creating a goal, or call `await auth.currentUser?.uid` via a page function. The tasks-toggle-* testids only render when the tasks list is in list-mode (not the split/two-pane view); toggle 'نمای دوپنله' off first. Smart profile pills prepend the emoji directly to the label with no space — that is intentional and does NOT constitute the '⏳ ⏳' double-emoji bug. Cloudflare bot challenge did not trigger during this run (kept reloads sparse).
rca_of_issue: Missing tasks-toggle-filter testid: search of SmartListProfileBar.tsx/TasksView.tsx will show the filter Button element does not have a data-testid attribute; adding data-testid="tasks-toggle-filter" to that Button will satisfy the spec. Kanban quick-add double '+': KanbanView quick-add input placeholder string literally begins with '+ افزودن…' while a sibling Plus icon is rendered; simply strip the leading '+ ' from that placeholder string (or the icon) to match the pattern used by QuickAddTask collapsed row on the other list pages.
